# Secondary analysis: drug-AKI associations (generated by `python -m polysafe.secondary`)

PREREGISTRATION section 10 and D11.1. **Associational, not causal.** 651 stays of the primary cohort with a medication record, 75 with AKI. Exposure: active medication order by T (D6.4), HICL + gtc. Adjustment: logit of a propensity score on the D4.4 reduced clinical set. 95% intervals: patient-level percentile bootstrap, 2,000 resamples, propensity model refitted in each. The analysis plan's details (D11.1) were fixed after the prediction results were seen and before any association was computed.

| Agent | Role | Exposed (events) | Unexposed events | Crude OR (95% CI) | Adjusted OR (95% CI) | Resamples used |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---:|
| vancomycin | pre-specified agent | 106 (14) | 61 | 1.21 (0.54-2.17) | 1.06 (0.49-2.01) | 2000 |
| piperacillin-tazobactam | pre-specified agent | 93 (17) | 58 | 1.93 (0.95-3.38) | 1.77 (0.89-3.22) | 2000 |
| furosemide | pre-specified agent | 141 (28) | 47 | 2.44 (1.45-3.90) | 1.97 (1.12-3.37) | 2000 |
| ondansetron | negative control | 314 (37) | 38 | 1.05 (0.63-1.71) | 1.24 (0.75-2.12) | 2000 |

## Overlap (no trimming)

| Agent | PS c-statistic | PS exposed p5 / p50 / p95 | PS unexposed p5 / p50 / p95 | Exposed outside unexposed range | Unexposed outside exposed range |
|---|---:|---|---|---:|---:|
| vancomycin | 0.70 | 0.08 / 0.19 / 0.57 | 0.05 / 0.13 / 0.32 | 2 | 27 |
| piperacillin-tazobactam | 0.69 | 0.07 / 0.17 / 0.40 | 0.04 / 0.12 / 0.30 | 0 | 25 |
| furosemide | 0.69 | 0.11 / 0.24 / 0.55 | 0.07 / 0.18 / 0.43 | 0 | 30 |
| ondansetron | 0.67 | 0.30 / 0.52 / 0.81 | 0.19 / 0.45 / 0.66 | 0 | 3 |

Negative control (section 10): ondansetron adjusted OR 1.24 (0.75-2.12). If it is of similar magnitude to the agents', the adjustment is inadequate and the agent estimates are not interpretable as drug effects.
